 State of Odisha ....

Opposite Party
 Mr. K.K. Das, Additional Standing Counsel
 Mr. S.P. Dash, counsel for informant
 Coram:
 Shri Justice B. P. Routray
 Order
The matter is taken up through hybrid mode.

2. Heard Mr. B. Maharatha, learned counsel for the Petitioner, Mr. K.K. Das, learned Additional Standing Counsel for Opposite Party - State and Mr. S.P. Dash, learned counsel for the informant.
3.

This is an application under Section 439 Cr.P.C. for grant of bail to the Petitioner Jitu @ Jiten Nayak in connection with Balanga P.S. Case No.69 of 2019, corresponding to T.R. Case No.45 of 2019 pending in the court of learned Additional Sessions Judge-cum-Judge, Special Court under POCSO Act, Puri for alleged commission of offence under Sections 376(2)(j)/376-AB/294/427/506 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 6 of the POCSO Act.

4. It is submitted on behalf of the Petitioner that he is inside custody since 8th June, 2019 and in the meantime 12 witnesses have already been examined including the victim, her mother and the informant.
It is further submitted that a false case has been foisted against the Petitioner for some dispute due to movement of vehicle.

5. Upon hearing both parties and perusal of depositions of the P.W. 1 to 12, as produced in course of hearing, and considering the circumstances of the case as well as the period of detention of the Petitioner inside custody, it is directed to release the Petitioner on bail in the aforesaid case on such terms and conditions to be fixed by the learned court in seisin over the matter including the condition that, the Petitioner shall not dissuade any witness directly or indirectly by way of inducement, threat or promise acquainted with the facts of the case from disclosing such facts before the Court or tamper with the evidence and that, he shall not be involved in any other offence Jitu @ Jiten Nayak vs State Of Odisha ....
